data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏書口舌禍來侵，将軍飛入悔心驚。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086303284","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"直符官災終不兑，","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086319668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330176501968797733"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是流年三殺星。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086319668","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580337795086319668","content":"直符会有官灾始终无法化解，这是流年的三杀星。"},{"logicSentenceId":"7580337795086303284","content":"奏书星引发口舌是非，灾祸来袭，将军飞入宫位就会有后悔之事令人心惊。"}]}

data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"○安截路空亡訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086336052","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"論本生年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳申酉宫，乙庚午未宫，丙辛辰巳宫，戌癸子丑宫，丁壬寅卯宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086352436","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580337795086352436","content":"甲巳对应申酉宫，乙庚对应午未宫，丙辛对应辰巳宫，戌癸对应子丑宫，丁壬对应寅卯宫。"}]}

data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"○安旬中空亡訣 ","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"論本生年","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子旬中空戌亥，甲戍旬中空申酉，甲申旬中空午未，甲午旬中空辰巳，甲辰旬中空寅卯，甲寅旬中空子丑。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086368820","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580337795086368820","content":"甲子旬中戌、亥为空亡，甲戌旬中申、酉为空亡，甲申旬中午、未为空亡，甲午旬中辰、巳为空亡，甲辰旬中寅、卯为空亡，甲寅旬中子、丑为空亡。"}]}

data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"○安大限訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽男隂女從命前一宫起，是父母宫；隂男陽女從命後一宫起，是兄弟宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086385204","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580337795086385204","content":"阳男阴女从命宫前一宫开始，就是父母宫；阴男阳女从命宫后一宫开始，就是兄弟宫。"}]}

data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330176536911314959"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"○安小限訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086401588","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"不論隂陽，男俱順数，不論隂陽，女俱逆数","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌人起辰宫，申子辰人起戌宫，巳酉丑人起未宫，亥卯未人起丑宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086417972","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580337795086417972","content":"出生年份地支为寅、午、戌的人从辰宫开始推算，出生年份地支为申、子、辰的人从戌宫开始推算，出生年份地支为巳、酉、丑的人从未宫开始推算，出生年份地支为亥、卯、未的人从丑宫开始推算。"}]}

data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"○安童限訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一命二財三疾厄，四妻五福六官禄。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086434356","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘年一泒順流行，十五命宫㸔端的。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086450740","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580337795086450740","content":"余下的宫位依次顺流行进，到第十五宫命宫时需详察其究竟。"},{"logicSentenceId":"7580337795086434356","content":"第一个宫位是命宫，第二个是财帛宫，第三个是疾厄宫，第四个是妻妾宫，第五个是福德宫，第六个是官禄宫。"}]}

data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"○安命主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼子宫，巨門，亥丑二宫，禄存，寅戍宫，文曲，卯酉宫，破軍午宫，𤎉貞申辰宫，武曲未巳宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795086467124","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580337795086467124","content":"贪狼星在子宫，巨门星在亥宫和丑宫，禄存星在寅宫和戌宫，文曲星在卯宫和酉宫，破军星在午宫，廉贞星在申宫和辰宫，武曲星在未宫和巳宫。"}]}

data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如午宫安命，尋破軍星在何宫，卯命主星也。","logicSentenceId":"7580338556200026152","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子宫安命，","logicSentenceId":"7580338556200042536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330176554300981298"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尋貪狼星，即命主也。","logicSentenceId":"7580338556200042536","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左輔隨丑至午，右弼隨亥至午。","logicSentenceId":"7580338556200058920","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580338556200042536","content":"在子宫定位命宫，寻找贪狼星，贪狼星就是命主星。"},{"logicSentenceId":"7580338556200058920","content":"左辅星从丑宫顺行到午宫，右弼星从亥宫顺行到午宫。"},{"logicSentenceId":"7580338556200026152","content":"假如在午宫安命，查找破军星在哪个宫，卯宫的星就是命主星。"}]}

data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"○安身主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午人火鈴星，丑未人天相星，寅申人天梁星，辰戍人文昌星，已亥人天機主，卯酉人天同星。","logicSentenceId":"7580338556200075304","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580338556200075304","content":"子年、午年出生的人，火铃星是命主星；丑年、未年出生的人，天相星是命主星；寅年、申年出生的人，天梁星是命主星；辰年、戌年出生的人，文昌星是命主星；巳年、亥年出生的人，天机星是命主星；卯年、酉年出生的人，天同星是命主星。"}]}

data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論安金鎻鉄蛇関","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"當從戌上起子年，順数行年月逆推，日又順数時又逆，小見夀夭可先知。","logicSentenceId":"7580338556200091688","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580338556200091688","content":"应当从戌宫起子年，年份顺数、月份逆推，日期再顺数、时辰又逆推，稍微推算就能预先知晓寿命长短。"}]}

data.content: {"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此法從戌上起年，順行至本生年，年上起月，逆数至本生月，月上起日，日上起時，逆至本生時。","logicSentenceId":"7580338556200108072","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇丑未宫病，有救，辰戍宫死。","logicSentenceId":"7580338556200124456","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
data.translateContent: {"sentences":[{"logicSentenceId":"7580338556200124456","content":"当推到丑宫、未宫时代表生病，有救；推到辰宫、戌宫时代表死亡。"},{"logicSentenceId":"7580338556200108072","content":"这个方法从戌宫开始起算年份，顺行到出生的年份，再从该年位起算月份，逆着顺序数到出生的月份，接着从该月位起算日期，再从该日位起算时辰，逆着顺序数到出生的时辰。"}]}
